status: All 14 project steps implemented; metric contract 1.1 retained
timestamp_convention: Source wall-clock timestamp, no timezone conversion

rfm.recency: Calendar days from last eligible purchase date to snapshot date
rfm.frequency: Distinct eligible invoices in the trailing 12 months
rfm.monetary: Eligible gross merchandise sales in the trailing 12 months

segments_first_match.label: Champions
segments_first_match.condition: frequency_12m >= 2 and recency_days <= 90 and R_score >= 4 and F_score >= 4 and M_score >= 4

segments_first_match.label: Promising New
segments_first_match.condition: frequency_12m == 1 and recency_days <= 90 and first_order_timestamp >= T - 30 days

repeat_purchase.repeat_event: second distinct eligible invoice timestamp <= first_order_timestamp + D days

cohort_retention.pooled_rate: sum(retained_customers) / sum(cohort_size) over mature in-scope cohorts

duplicate_handling.cross_sheet_unit: Invoice payload multiset of eight normalized source fields
duplicate_handling.within_sheet_primary: Retain earliest of identical eight-field rows in retained invoice version
duplicate_handling.within_sheet_sensitivity: Retain repeated within-sheet rows and quantify changes

purchase_scope.product_role: Classified merchandise only; unresolved special codes excluded with quantified exposure
purchase_scope.refund_linkage: Not assumed; historical purchase events are not retroactively removed

price_normalization.rule: Half-up to six decimal places only for finite prices with absolute deviation at most the stated tolerance; preserve raw text and correction flag
price_normalization.evidence: Step 5: 112879 serialized prices; maximum deviation 0.000000000003 GBP

comparison.value_bands: Positive values; lower bound inclusive except zero; upper bound exclusive; final band unbounded
comparison.confidence_interval: 95% Wilson interval for unadjusted binomial rates only

revenue_concentration.ranking: historical_sales_gbp descending, then customer_id ascending ordinal text
revenue_concentration.denominator: Gross merchandise sales of all identified historical customers

order_sequence_tie_break: invoice_id ascending ordinal text after order_timestamp
documented_limitations: Unresolved product exposure, unknown customer identity, observational comparisons and historical-source limitations must accompany final conclusions
